source_row.rationale: Metoprolol succinate is an extended-release formulation commonly dosed once daily. Metoprolol tartrate is immediate-release and is generally dosed more frequently. Formulation changes should follow the prescribed conversion rather than informal substitution.
source_row.source_detail: Metoprolol formulation labeling: succinate extended-release versus tartrate immediate-release; reviewed 2026-08-14.
